entities.summary: Giulio Prinetti was a performers & entertainers in Milan (1851-06-06, Milan – 1908-06-09) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
